sources.relevant_fact: The published diffusion protocol averages2ps velocity correlations from100consecutive4ps NVE trajectories with Maxwell refreshes, repeating this20times. The proposed20ps/10ps diffusion study is a new finite-time-regime check, not that published protocol.
sources.title: Competing quantum effects in the dynamics of a flexible water model

sources.relevant_fact: Short-time MSD nonlinearities and correlations between MSD values require careful estimator/uncertainty design. Here the point estimate remains fixed-window OLS for continuity, while uncertainty is taken across complete independent seed-chain means, not OLS residuals.
sources.title: Optimal estimates of diffusion coefficients from molecular dynamics simulations
